headline: Obama order sets who would lead the Justice Department if top officials are unable to serve.
what_it_does: This executive order sets an order of succession inside the Department of Justice. It lists which officials would act as Attorney General if the Attorney General and other top leaders die, resign, or cannot do the job. Orders like this are meant to keep the department running without a gap in leadership. The title alone does not give the full list of officials named.

who_it_affects.how: Certain officials are placed in a set order to temporarily take on the Attorney General's duties if higher-ranking leaders are unavailable.

when_it_takes_effect: Likely upon signing on January 13, 2017, though the source provided does not say.
